result.response:
The adjuster console has been rebuilt to match the **"Evidence Desk"** design from the reference screenshots [design-ref/today.png](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/design-ref/today.png) and [design-ref/claim.png](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/design-ref/claim.png).

### Summary of Implementation

1. **Design Tokens & Shell** ([app/static/style.css](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/static/style.css), [app/templates/base.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/base.html)):
   - Configured Google Fonts: *"Plus Jakarta Sans"* for the UI, *"Source Serif 4"* for the claim document, and *"IBM Plex Mono"* for IDs and hashes.
   - Defined all design token variables: canvas (`#eef1f5`), frame (`#f7f8fa`), card (`#ffffff`), cell (`#f3f6f8`), ink (`#111c2b`), mute (`#5a6b7d`), line (`#e4e8ee`), brand (`#1673e6`), status tones, 28px frame radius, and 20px card radius.
   - Built the outer shell:
     - Left sidebar with the brand shield tile, "Evidence Desk" header, live badge count for claims needing a decision, navigation ("Today", "New capture link", "Verify a package", and admin section), bottom "Built with Gemini" card, and adjuster profile.
     - Top search bar with client-side filtering, keyboard shortcut (`/`), bell icon, and user badge.
     - Dismissible demo workspace notice banner (stored in browser storage).
     - Responsive stacking for screens $\le 900\text{px}$ and $\le 480\text{px}$.

2. **Today Dashboard (`/console`)** ([app/templates/console_list.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/console_list.html)):
   - Header with active subline and "New capture link" button.
   - Dismissible "Try it in 3 steps" card remembered in `localStorage`.
   - Four stat cards: "Waiting for your decision", "Mismatch found", "Waiting for the claimant", and "Link to report".
   - Claims table sorted with red mismatches first, then amber reviews, clear matches, and waiting claimants (newest first within each group). Includes client-side filter pills ("All", "Needs me", "Mismatch", "Waiting for claimant", "Decided").
   - Right column featuring the pure HTML/CSS weekly distribution chart and live "Gemini today" metrics.

3. **Claim Workspace (`/console/claims/{id}`)** ([app/templates/console_claim.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/console_claim.html)):
   - Breadcrumb bar with dynamic "Next claim, $k$ of $n$" queue badge.
   - Left desk panel holding the white paper "Automobile Loss Notice" in *Source Serif 4*:
     - Ruled sections for "1. What happened" and "2. Your vehicle".
     - $2\times 2$ photo grid with dynamic red/amber border highlights, numbered finding marker badges, figure captions, and clickable full-resolution overlay inspection.
     - Footer with cryptographic Ed25519 signature summary and round teal `SEALED` stamp.
   - Right review panel:
     - "In short" AI summary sentences with citation pills and deterministic engine fallback.
     - Numbered findings grouped under "Vehicle and plate", "Damage", and "Photo integrity", with status pills and interactive "Confirm" / "False alarm" buttons.
     - "Suggested next step" card (amber for review, green for fast track).
     - "Your decision" card with full-width "Approve" and two-up "Request recapture" and "Refer to SIU" (no reject button).
     - "Report files" card for downloading and verifying sealed packages.

4. **New Capture Link & Verify** ([app/templates/console_new.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/console_new.html), [app/templates/console_created.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/console_created.html), [app/templates/verify.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/verify.html)):
   - Grouped desktop 2-column form for new claims.
   - Created screen with QR code and copyable link with inline "Copied" feedback.
   - Drop-zone verification card with cryptographic signature verification alerts.

5. **Adjuster Finding Label Endpoint & Database** ([app/main.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/main.py), [app/db.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/db.py)):
   - Added `POST /console/claims/{id}/findings/{check}/label` accepting only `confirm` or `false_alarm`.
   - Added `adjuster_label` column to SQLite `findings` table.

6. **Test Coverage** ([tests/test_evidence_desk.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/tests/test_evidence_desk.py)):
   - Added tests verifying: the 4 stat cards and filter pills, red claims sorting above clear claims, claim workspace notice and decision buttons without any reject button, and strict validation of the finding label endpoint.
